programme.desc: Fineasz Flynn i jego przyrodni brat Ferb Fletcher uznali za swoją misję pokonanie nudy i sprawienie, aby każdy z 104 dni wakacji był wyjątkowy. Ich starsza siostra Fretka nie cierpi niesamowitych przygód swoich braci. Poświęca więc cały swój czas, donosząc na nich mamie i tacie, lecz jakoś nigdy nie udaje jej się dowieść wybryków chłopców. programme.desc: Były doradca obozowy Lou Hockhauser (Miranda May) kupuje za dolara Kikiwakę od rodzeństwa Ross. Z początkiem lata kobieta przygotowuje się do nowych obowiązków dyrektora. Jednak zamiast organizować naprawę kanalizacji i zatrudnić kucharza, wolałaby pływać kajakiem po jeziorze lub spędzać wolny czas w Chatce Woodchuck. Podekscytowana czeka na ponowne przybycie obozowiczów, w tym jej kuzyna Finna (Will Buie Jr.) oraz Destiny (Mallory James Mahoney) i Matteo (Raphael Alejandro). Młodzi ludzie chętnie powracają w znane sobie miejsce, a każdy z nich dowiaduje się o sobie czegoś nowego.

programme.desc: Inspector Abhijeet Rai leads a harmonious life with his pregnant wife Rajni. His life comes crashing down when Kaliram, a man he had arrested five years ago, returns in his life to take revenge.

programme.title: Shreeman Aashique
programme.desc: Vishwamitra, the founder of a group that dissuades marriages, and his follower, Dushant, fall in love with Shakuntala, who likes Dushant. But Vishwamitra creates misunderstandings between the two.

programme.title: Kaise Kaise Log
programme.desc: Ravi falls in love with Pooja but is forced to marry a multi-millionaire and US settled heiress, Pinky. Who will Ravi finally tie the knot with.

programme.title: Waqt Ki Awaz
programme.desc: Lata runs away from home in order to avoid an arranged marriage. She meets and falls in love with truck driver Vishwa, but her hopes are crushed when she learns that he is a murderer.

programme.title: Conversation With Rajkummar Rao 1
programme.desc: Rajkummar Rao, one of the most talented and versatile actors today, talks about his being an outsider to the industry, the different shades of unique characters he plays and his success.

programme.title: Awaargi
programme.desc: Azad rescues a girl from a brothel, attracting the ire of the mob, and helps her achieve her dream with Dhiren's aid. However, both the men fall in love with her while the mobs seek revenge on Azad.

programme.title: Yakeen
programme.desc: A couple meets with a car accident. The husband suffering from amnesia finds evidence, that all had not been well in his previous life. He grows suspicious of the people around him including his wife.

programme.title: Karm
programme.desc: Asha and Arvind live together and soon start making plans for the new addition in the family. What she does not know is that Arvind has met a young woman named Neelam Shukla who wants to marry him.

programme.title: Dil Hai Ke Manta Nahi
programme.desc: Pooja runs away from home to be with her boyfriend. On her way, she meets Raghu, who agrees to escort her to her destination, and falls in love with him.

programme.title: Neend Hamari Khwab Tumhare
programme.desc: Nishad, who belongs to a noble Muslim family, is in love with Anwar. When everything seems to be working in their favour, a secret from Anwar's family threatens to end their relationship.

programme.title: Rafoo Chakkar
programme.desc: Two friends witness a murder by three criminals. They flee the scene, with the criminals in hot pursuit. What one of the criminals does not know is that he is out to kill his own son.

programme.title: Conversation With Javed Akhtar 1
programme.desc: Lyricist, poet, screenwriter, Javed Akhtar along with film expert Nasreen Ali and Shabana Azmi, provides a fascinating and personal insight into his extraordinary life and new book Talking Life.

programme.title: Comedy Station - Bittu Bak Bak
programme.desc: Series of short, comedic vignettes where an unlucky Bhojpuri producer Champaklal and his secretary Suzie hilariously navigate chaotic, low-budget filmmaking, trying to outsmart each other.

programme.title: Damaad
programme.desc: Sharad is head over the heels in love with Renu, his neighbour's daughter. However, problems arise when two of his employers want him to get married to either of their daughters.

programme.title: Ghar Grihasti
programme.desc: Janki Deshmukh, a young, attractive and compassionate young woman, faces many trials and tribulations throughout her life.

programme.title: Mela
programme.desc: Bansilal, Baniya and Kanhaiya live in a small village, which is governed by a panchayat. Frustrated by the dictatorship of the system, the three men decide to fight against it.

programme.title: Balika Badhu
programme.desc: Arduous journey of child bride Rajni who is married before she is old enough to understand what marriage is all about, against the backdrop of Indian freedom struggle.

programme.title: Samundar
programme.desc: An evil man Raiszada frames an innocent man for the murder of a police man, years pass by Raiszada takes full care of the police man's son, and fills his heart and mind with rage for the innocent man.

programme.title: Khwab
programme.desc: Pratap travels to Mumbai for better career opportunities. He gains success and falls in love with the daughter of his boss. On the day of his engagement, Pratap gets arrested for a murder.

programme.title: Ram Balram
programme.desc: Jagatpal raises his nephews, Ram and Balram, after killing their parents. He hatches an evil plan to push Ram into the world of smuggling and earn money, but the brothers unite to take him down.

programme.title: Dil E Nadaan
programme.desc: Unaware of each other's feelings, thick pals Vikram and Anand fall for the same woman. However, an unexpected incident changes their lives forever.

programme.title: Bade Ghar Ki Beti
programme.desc: Mala, a virtuous girl, marries into a wealthy family. She faces opposition from her jealous sisters-in-law but eventually wins their hearts with her kindness and resilience.

programme.title: Rakhawala
programme.desc: A village girl seeks her father in Bombay. Kind Vikram wants to help, but she knows neither his name nor has a photo, leaving him helpless.

programme.title: The Real Hunter

programme.title: Sweekar Kiya Maine
programme.desc: After Gopika and Kishan get married, she learns that her husband is a widower and has a child. She leaves him but later returns, asking him to accept her son from a previous relationship.

programme.title: Anokhi Ada
programme.desc: Lalaji and Gupta, two business partners, take their relationship to the next level when their children, Rakesh and Neeta, marry each other. However, chaos ensues when Lalaji helps Gopal, a stranger.

programme.title: Blackmail
programme.desc: Dev discovers that his wife, Reena, has been cheating on him with Ranjit. To teach them a lesson, he decides to blackmail the cheating duo as part of his revenge.

programme.title: Kahani Kismat Ki
programme.desc: A reformed man tries to make an honest living for himself and his family after his jail term. His life takes an ugly turn when a woman claims him to be her husband and he is also framed for murder.

programme.title: Khel
programme.desc: Three fraudsters trick a rich elderly woman, Sulakshana, who is desperately looking for her long-lost grandchild, in order to acquire her estate and property.

programme.title: Drishyam
programme.desc: When the disappearance of a policewoman's son threatens to ruin Vijay's family, he leaves no stone unturned in order to shield his family.

programme.title: Powerfull Yoddha
programme.desc: Chandu is very passionate about kickboxing and his life revolves around his mother and his girlfriend. His life is shattered when his dying mother asks him to meet his estranged father Raghuveer.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: Pyar Ki Kahani
programme.desc: Ram, a peon, forms a close friendship with a man named Ravi and values his opinion. However, he is shocked when Ravi disapproves of his fiancee and gets more upset when he learns the reason why.

programme.title: Kab? Kyoon? Aur Kahan?
programme.desc: Asha, a rich man's daughter, is arrested for her uncle's murder. Inspector Anand, who loves her, tries his best to solve the case and save her.

programme.title: Taqdeer Ka Tamasha

programme.title: Ek Se Bure Do
programme.desc: Jagat, a gangster, hires Toti and Tony to steal a treasure map. But they provide him with a fake copy of the map and reserve the original. When Jagat learns about it, he plans to teach them a lesson.

programme.title: Shehzaade

programme.title: Race

programme.title: Jadugar Ki Kahar
programme.desc: Bollywood drama starring Devaraj, 2009.

programme.title: Jagan

programme.title: Johny I Love You
programme.desc: Suraj Singh, a former bandit, relocates to a small hillside after the death of his wife, Savitri. He changes his son Raju's name to Johny to save him from the wrath of his former partner.

programme.title: International Crook
programme.desc: Rajesh, a superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend Shekar in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler who is involved in a spree of illegal activities.

programme.title: Main Intequam Loonga
programme.desc: Kumar learns that his father, a national level boxing champion, was killed when he refused to lose a fight. He vows to annihilate his father's killers, unaware that he may face tragic consequences.

programme.title: Ajab Gazabb Love
programme.desc: Rajveer, a rich man, falls in love with Madhuri. However, he soon realises that she detests affluent people and in order to win her heart, he, along with his family, pretends to be poor.

programme.title: Saajan Ki Saheli
programme.desc: Kunti abandons her baby in order to lead a lavish life and marries a rich man. Years later, she realises that her husband is indulging in an affair and is shocked to find out the truth about the girl.

programme.title: Haisiyat

programme.title: Ek Aur Bhool Bhulaiyaa

programme.title: Anari Ishq
programme.desc: Rama, a simpleton, is appointed as the bodyguard of Rajnandini, a rich girl. She soon falls in love with him but her brothers' violent nature gets in the way of her uniting with Rama.

programme.title: Teri Kasam
programme.desc: Dolly, a rich and spoilt woman, falls for Tony, a poor musician, and marries him. However, her arrogance begins to create problems in their marital life.

programme.title: Mast
programme.desc: Kittu is madly in love with Malika, an actress, and travels to her house in Mumbai from Pune after his father scolds him for his decreasing exam scores.

programme.title: Mera Karam Mera Dharam
programme.desc: Ajay, a businessman, provides funds to Sarjuprasad to develop his hometown. When he learns that the money has been misappropriated by Sarjuprasad, he resolves to set things right.

programme.title: Nazar Ke Samne
programme.desc: Jai, an unemployed drunk, gives false testimony that puts an innocent man in jail for murder. However, he later relents and tries to exonerate him by searching for the real killer.

programme.title: Dhadkan
programme.desc: Anjali and Dev are in love with each other and plan to marry, but her family gets her married to Ram. Years later, Dev shows up to reunite with Anjali, however, she has fallen in love with Ram.
